case.title: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH. Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation. Need: 23400 pc a year. Category goal: secure supply of a bottleneck part: coverage of the full need and a supplier that stays healthy come first. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 42 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: volume_per_year >= 22230. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

You are working with tight seal capacity, so what matters is that every unit you allocate to us is planned and committed. Our proposal gives you exactly that: a binding annual volume over a longer contract term, and your own lead time.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives Ravensteiner a firm volume and a longer term to plan against, and it brings the price into line with the cost and quality picture below.

On the cost side:
Our cost estimate for Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM is EUR 24.31 per unit (cost:340010).

On quality:
Your quality was 270 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70410@2026Q3).

On price history:
Our orders of Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM with you were placed at EUR 29.89 on 2024-10-07 (po:4500011517-10), EUR 29.89 on 2025-05-19 (po:4500012472-10), EUR 29.89 on 2026-01-19 (po:4500013451-10) and EUR 29.89 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014436-10): the price has been unchanged.

Here is our term sheet:
Our proposal: unit price EUR 28.50; binding volume 23,400 units per year; contract term 24 months; lead time 42 days.
Binding volume in every option: 23,400 units a year over 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Since a step of this size may need your pricing committee, Option A can be taken there as it stands: a binding volume every year, a longer contract term, and a reliable partner who has bought from you at a stable price. Please take it to them on our behalf.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

Our offer is a price of €33.60 per unit, Lieferzeit 42 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. 

Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 54 days: €31.70 per unit, with a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. In exchange for a price reduction, we must maintain the lead time at 54 days.

We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have verified your cost and quality records. We accept the volume of 23,400 units and the 24-month contract term. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown. We meet the agreed quality targets. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days.

This offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

You asked us to decide, and we have: we accept your alternative proposal as offered, with the longer lead time in exchange for the lower unit price. Your final offer gives both sides what matters most, a binding volume and a contract term you can plan your capacity against.

Thank you also for checking the cost and quality records and for taking them into account. We are not asking you to open your calculation.

Our proposal: unit price EUR 31.70; binding volume 23,400 units per year; contract term 24 months; lead time 56 days.
Binding volume in every option: 23,400 units a year over 24 months.

This is Option A, the package we can approve. It commits us to the full volume over the full term, which is the planning security you need for your tight seal capacity, and it keeps to the price and lead time you proposed.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We acknowledge your decision to proceed with our alternative proposal. We can accept your terms and await your order. We accept your term sheet at EUR 31.70 per unit for a volume of 23,400 units per year, a 24-month contract term, and a lead time of 56 days. 

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €31.70 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. This offer stays valid for 14 days. 

We will issue the order confirmation accordingly. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your order. Our order confirmation is attached.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
